dimension_2_pixel_architecture.description: Examines resolution, frame rate (FPS), duration, aspect ratio, and total frame buffer depth.
dimension_2_pixel_architecture.title: Dimension 2: Spatial Geometry & Temporal Framing Architecture

dimension_3_prnu_sensor_noise.description: Monitors photon shot noise and PRNU stability across temporal frame samples.
dimension_3_prnu_sensor_noise.diagnosis: Authentic camera sensor shot noise preserved across sampled frames.
dimension_3_prnu_sensor_noise.title: Dimension 3: Sensor Shot Noise & Micro-Grain Consistency

dimension_4_surface_smoothness.description: Tracks optical flow continuity to detect liquid limb morphing and unnatural physics.
dimension_4_surface_smoothness.diagnosis: Natural Newtonian motion dynamics and smooth inter-frame optical flow.
dimension_4_surface_smoothness.title: Dimension 4: Inter-Frame Motion Vectors & Morphological Warping

dimension_5_fourier_fft_decay.description: Detects high-frequency luminance fluctuations characteristic of frame-by-frame diffusion generation.
dimension_5_fourier_fft_decay.diagnosis: Temporal luminance stability aligns with physical camera shutter exposure.
dimension_5_fourier_fft_decay.title: Dimension 5: Temporal Diffusion Flickering & Latent Drift

dimension_6_subject_genre.description: Catalogs entities, persons, faces, scene settings, and environmental lighting.
dimension_6_subject_genre.title: Dimension 6: Visual Genre & Semantic Subject-Matter Catalog

dimension_7_visual_medium.description: Distinguishes physical camera capture from Sora, Runway Gen-2/Gen-3, Kling, Luma, or 3D CGI.
dimension_7_visual_medium.title: Dimension 7: Video Synthesis Medium & Generative Model Archetype

dimension_8_sensor_spectrum.description: Evaluates color dynamics, dynamic range, and highlight/shadow preservation across frames.
dimension_8_sensor_spectrum.title: Dimension 8: Sensor Spectrum & Dynamic Range

dimension_9_generative_attribution.description: Matches forensic fingerprints against known video foundation generators (Sora, Runway, Pika, Kling, Luma).
dimension_9_generative_attribution.title: Dimension 9: Foundation Model Attribution & Watermarking
